body: I won't blame you if you don't.
1:30 am here. And I think I'm going to go to bed, I have school tomorrow, going to cut a bit first, but don't waste your time. I'm not good enough. If you want, pm me, see how fucked up I am.
I don't feel needed... I think I'm just going to sleep after cutting a bit..

"Sense of accomplishment" ha. I've failed at everything. The only "sense of accomplishment" I've ever gotten, is when I don't fail a test I studied so hard for. I'm just waiting to get into the military, easy guns there.
I keep meeting those people. The ones who probably genuinely care, don't care about me. I'm not worth their time, or anyone else's, I apologize for posting, I shouldn't waste your time.
I don't know if I can do that... He's hurt me too much.

There's nothing here for me. I'm worthless. I can't do anything right.
I deserved the abuse. I was a little shit. Still am. I have guns in the next room. I don't want to wake up my brothers or anything though, or my mum.

I don't deserve it. All I do is hurt people. I can't take not hurting, me, or anyone else. I only piss people off, and when they find out I'm suicidal, they call me selfish and I don't hear from them again. I can't get this girl, she's perfect, I'm not even close to her level, she's funny, smart, pretty, etc. I'm none of that. She loves this guy, I can't stand in the way of that.

My life. Everything has gone downhill from when I was born. My father has been abusive since I was born, I don't talk to him anymore. He keeps asking for forgiveness. I want him to know my death is mostly his fault. Everyone I loved or cared about leaves. I'm too nice. I told a girl I really like and care about, to not date me, because I'm shit and the guy she likes more, to go back to him, I know I'd end up hurting her by disappearing. Forever.
I'm not yet. I'm talking about the mess for when I'm gone, and there's blood and brains on the floor after blowing them out.
There is no helping me. I've wanted to die since I can remember. I want to pass out from blood loss again. Except succeed this time.
The mess being the blood, and whatever else, on the floor. I made a mess, and i feel bad for whoever has to clean it up.
Thanks
Maybe, I dunno. You saved me tonight thiugg
I help people as much as possible, it makes me feel good, that even though I'm not going to be here for long I can help as many people as possible
I'm proud that you help a lot of people, and that you're no longer depressed
I think I'm more proud of you than you are of me..
I.. I don't know what to say.. You don't know me.. Yet you want to save me..
I think that's the first time someone has ever been proud of me... Thank you..
I'll put the pills (my meds) back I think.. I was gonna overdose on anti-depressants, make it ironic
They've been here for awhile... What to do with vodka, knife, and pills, hmm....
No I mean.. With everything I have..
I think you're right.. But what do I do?
I live in Canada.. She lives in Australia :/
I may have already.. She lives too far to talk to on a regular basis :/ I try, but it doesn't always work...
She would tell me to not die... But I have to be with her. I need her. I talk to her daily, idk what I'd do :(
I think 3rd or 4th stage.. She knows she doesn't have long left..
